name: The Stolen Flour
initial_prompt: Recover as much of the village flour as possible without needlessly harming Toma.
storyteller_summary: Toma, an injured former farmhand, took flour because he is hungry and fears the constable. Mara wants the flour returned but does not want Toma badly hurt.

gm.opening: The Adventurer starts near the hut. Mara and the hut are separate areas within this one location; moving between them is a normal move, not travel.

storyteller.stakes: The flour feeds several households. Toma values freedom and survival more than the flour.

locations.name: charcoal hut
locations.description: A low charcoal-burner's hut of warped boards. The front door is barred from inside; an open rear window is large enough to crawl through. A narrow crawlspace runs beneath the rear wall. Mara can meet the Adventurer outside, while Toma shelters inside.

gm.exterior: A careful look at the rear reveals a loose floorboard, torn waxed cloth, mouse-chewed crumbs, and old charcoal-burner cache markings. Do not require a roll to notice these signs when examined.
gm.interior: Toma sits beside a weak fire. An open sack of flour, scattered flour, flatbread, a wood axe, and his swollen wrapped leg are visible through cracks or the rear window.

storyteller.constraint: Mara and the hut remain areas within this location for the proof of concept; the GM must describe distance and movement between them.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.description: The village storehouse keeper who asks the Adventurer to recover the flour. She is angry but does not want Toma badly hurt.
npcs.background: Mara knows Toma injured his leg, has struggled to work, has begged for food, and fears the constable.
npcs.motive: Recover enough flour for the village without making Toma's situation worse.
npcs.ambition: Keep the settlement fed and avoid needless harm.

gm.dialogue: Mara says: Toma took one of the large sacks and ran to the old charcoal hut. We need back whatever remains. Please don't kill him over it.

npcs.name: Toma
npcs.description: An injured former farmhand sheltering in the hut. His leg is swollen and poorly wrapped; he can walk, stand and fight, but cannot move quickly with the flour or climb through the window with it.
npcs.background: Toma stole a sack of flour after being unable to find work and fearing imprisonment by the constable.
npcs.motive: Avoid imprisonment and find enough food, warmth, and help to reach another settlement.
npcs.ambition: Survive without further injury, keeping as much flour as he can if possible.

beliefs: Anyone sent by Mara may intend to capture him.
A verbal promise alone is unreliable.
Killing the Adventurer would bring worse consequences.

items.name: flour sack
items.description: An opened large sack of flour, enough to feed several households when full.

gm.state: Some flour is scattered across the hut floor.

items.name: emergency cache
items.description: A cache beneath the loose floorboard containing dried food, a waterskin, a wool cloak, copper coins, and a rusted charcoal-burner's hook.

gm.access: Reaching into the crawlspace from outside places the Adventurer beneath the rear window and occupies both hands. If Toma is unaware or distracted, taking it may require no save.
